thag3.14:1.1: Saṃsaraṃ hi nirayaṃ agacchisaṃ, petalokam agamaṃ punappunaṃ, dukkhamamhi pi tiracchānayoniyā nekadhā hi vusitaṃ ciraṃ mayā. || ||
thag3.14:2.1: mānuso pi ca bhavo 'bhirādhito, saggakāyam agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu n' evasaññisu asaññisu ṭṭhitaṃ. || ||
thag3.14:3.1: sambhavā suviditā asārakā saṃkhatā pacalitā sad' eritā; taṃ viditvā maham attasambhavaṃ santim eva satimā samajjhagan ti. || || Gotamo thero.
